title: BlueScope Steel Ltd - proposed acquisition of Smorgon Steel Distribution

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC decision delayed pending further discussions with the parties involved in the proposals to acquire Smorgon.
ACCC announced decision not to oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Competition analysis: For detailed competition analysis, please see the Public Competition Assessment below.
